question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL THEN 'No item line' 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line' 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multi item line' 
  END AS ORDER_TYPE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS AVG_UNITS_PER_ORDER
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ORDER_TYPE
ORDER BY 
  CASE ORDER_TYPE 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 0 
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Multi item line' THEN 2 
    ELSE 3 END
action.metrics: Order count, total units, average units per order by order type (no item line, one item line, multi item line)
action.group_by: Order type (no item line, one item line, multi item line)

action.metrics: Order count, share, and average units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; orders with no item line.
action.group_by: Order type (one item line, multi item line, no item line)
action.answer: In 2025, there were 1,307,684 orders with exactly one item line and 3,052,089 orders with more than one item line. No orders were found with zero item lines. The share of orders with more than one item line was 69.99% (3,052,089 out of 4,359,773 total orders). The average ordered units per order was 1.219753 for one-line orders and 3.484769 for multi-line orders. Interpretation: Most orders (about 70%) contained multiple item lines, and these orders had a much higher average number of units per order compared to single-line orders. No orders were missing item lines in the data.
action.reason: All requested values are present in the query result. The share is calculated as multi-line orders divided by total orders. No orders with zero item lines were found.
